mapper.update: UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'DISPATCHED', dispatched_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED')

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'RETURNED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'CONFIRMED')

UPDATE mq_message_status SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{errorMessage}, 1000), next_attempt_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED')
